decisions.reason: The financing-structure decision does not alter capex estimates, assumption basis, or shared-program capex treatment; the separate capex clause in the same message is already represented.
Confirming temporary financing assumptions does not change the requirement to document assumptions or the general policy for unavailable inputs.
The 70/30 single-tranche financing assumptions are inputs to the model but do not change its integrated three-statement structure or financial-engine basis.
The financing-structure decision does not change operating-expenditure assumptions; the independent opex decision in the same message is already represented.
Debt/equity structure, financing rate, and mezzanine treatment do not alter the eight-site network configuration; the separate site-list decision is already represented.
Interest rate is already a sensitivity variable, and the confirmed base financing rate does not change the required sensitivity-variable set.
The temporary capital-stack assumptions do not change the required user-funded and PPP scenario definitions or the availability-payment justification.
The financing decision does not modify revenue streams, pricing assumptions, or revenue-assumption documentation.
The capital-stack decision does not change Canadian tax or CCA treatment; the independent CCA instruction in the same message is already represented.
Financing assumptions may affect calculated outputs, but they do not change the candidate's DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria, which are separately specified in the same message.
Confirming temporary financing assumptions does not change source-data verification requirements or the designated roles of the reference materials.
The financing-structure decision does not alter the model's CAD currency or 2026 price-base year.
